reason: The design controls for pre-treatment confounders (size, age, baseline outcome) and correctly leaves out the post-period collaboration index, which is a mediator. Adding the other 2020 covariates, dropping the trim, and adding the categorical variables all leave the estimate near -0.27 to -0.31 and non-significant (p of 0.17 to 0.26). The unadjusted +1.6 is explained by baseline confounding. 'No effect' is acceptable because the outcome is around 100 patents per 100 engineers and the CI is narrow, though the report should say 'no detectable effect'.
